summary: Opt-in Flash/Haiku pre-review layer: per-task /z-execute gate-down via runtime.impl_pre_review (skips codex on eligible low-tier CLEAN verdicts) plus the shared pre-reviewer/complexity-classifier subagents; both gate-down and the sibling runtime.pre_review context-prep cycles (z-review-all, z-audit-plan) default off and fail safe toward full reviewer coverage.

entry_points.summary: Default-off per-task gate-down header; cost-inversion caveat and unconditional-init requirement.
Requires runtime.impl_pre_review=true and CYCLE==1; retry cycles bypass gate-down.
Strips cached **Complexity:** line, dispatches complexity-classifier, drift-up forces codex.
Eligible low-tier tasks call pre-reviewer; CLEAN emits review_gated_down and skips codex; blockers/majors prepend and escalate.
Pre-reviewer may supply advisory FLASH_PREPEND for medium/high tiers but cannot gate codex.
Codex/self-review/advisory reviewer sections nested under PRE_REVIEW_GATED_DOWN != 1 (closes at line 2916).
Read-only Flash false-negative audit harness; samples review_gated_down events and re-runs codex.
final-review-prong-a/b, final-review-quality, and plan-audit; output ends with VERDICT.
Returns user-authored tier when **Complexity:** is present, so gate-down callers must strip it for drift detection.

invariants: Both knobs default false and ship inert.
runtime.impl_pre_review gate-down only runs on cycle 1.
Pre-reviewer provider unavailable or malformed verdict falls through to codex.
Only eligible low-tier CLEAN can set PRE_REVIEW_GATED_DOWN=1.
PRE_REVIEW_GATE_DOWN and PRE_REVIEW_GATED_DOWN are distinct and load-bearing.
runtime.pre_review in z-review-all and z-audit-plan never skips production consultants.
gotchas: Cost inversion is possible; audit review_gated_down misses before recommending enablement.
The cached **Complexity:** line must be stripped before tier-drift re-check.
pre-reviewer is line-cited and noise-averse, not a final correctness oracle.
Legacy env aliases exist, but TOML runtime.* keys are canonical.
A malformed VERDICT is treated as empty and falls through to codex.
skills/z-execute/SKILL.md line numbers shift substantially between refreshes due to unrelated feature growth earlier in the file; re-verify every refresh.
runtime.pre_review now also gates a Phase 2.5 cycle in z-audit-plan (skills/z-audit-plan/SKILL.md:397), not just z-review-all Phase 3.6 — discovered this refresh.
